description: Get replication divergence for a primary: the per-replica offset gap series (bytes behind as the primary sees it, write rate, seconds behind, `replicaGapBytes` as the replica reports it with `replicaView` saying whether it could be read (`ok`, `unreachable`, `replid_mismatch`, `not_replica`, or null when it was not sampled), live alert level, `behind` when it lags under the alert thresholds or has an event left open by a restart, or `unobserved` when the replica is not connected) and the divergence events from the anomaly store; `eventsUnavailable: true` means the events could not be read, not that there are none. Use when a replica is falling behind under write load, to see whether the gap is growing, at a ceiling, or not closing after the burst, and whether the replica agrees with the primary on how far behind it is. Companion to get_anomalies.

startTime.description: Start time (Unix timestamp ms; default 1h ago for the gap series, 24h ago for events)

name: get_replication_divergence
